dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Since the fate of the Tzitzimimeh has been obscured, they can't operate at their full strength here. But the good news is, our current proximity to the Ley Lines has enhanced my own abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Just what is this place? It's truly full of mysteries...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Well, I have all the time in the world, so I might as well find a free corner and move all my stuff in. Then I can start trying to figure out what all of this really means...
